key: Light becomes dark as dark becomes light. Truth becomes hidden, twisted in lie.
en: Light becomes dark as dark becomes light. Truth becomes hidden, twisted in lie.
ja: 光は闇となり、闇は光となる。真実は隠され、うそへとねじ曲げられる。

key: Each power its own seeks to impart Itself unto the innocent heart.
en: Each power its own seeks to impart Itself unto the innocent heart.
ja: それぞれの力は、むくな心へと、自らを刻み込もうとする。

key: Those of the light- speak only the truth. Those of the dark- speak within lies.
en: Those of the light- speak only the truth. Those of the dark- speak within lies.
ja: 光の者は、真実のみを語る。闇の者は、うその中に語る。

key: The divine will distinguish and ably sleuth The right from the wrong; the dark from the light.
en: The divine will distinguish and ably sleuth The right from the wrong; the dark from the light.
ja: 神の意志は、正と誤を、闇と光を、見分け、巧みに解き明かすだろう。

key: Clefable says:\n"Clefairy always tells the truth, but Cleffa is a liar."
en: Clefable says:\n"Clefairy always tells the truth, but Cleffa is a liar."
ja: ピクシーは言う:\n「ピッピは常に真実を語るが、ピィはうそつきだ」

key: Clefairy says:\n"Clefable has turned to darkness, but Cleffa remains in the light."
en: Clefairy says:\n"Clefable has turned to darkness, but Cleffa remains in the light."
ja: ピッピは言う:\n「ピクシーは闇に堕ちたが、ピィは光の中に留まっている」

key: Cleffa says:\n"Clefairy speaks truth, but Clefable is a descendent of the darkness."
en: Cleffa says:\n"Clefairy speaks truth, but Clefable is a descendent of the darkness."
ja: ピィは言う:\n「ピッピは真実を語るが、ピクシーは闇の子孫だ」
